DOP: tasiṇā tasinā f. [ BHS tasiṇā; S. tṛṣṇā], thirst; craving ; S V 58, 14 (tisso imā bhikkhave tasinā, Be, Ee so; Se taṇhā; Ce omits ); Dhp 342 (~āya purakkhatā pajā; Dhp-a IV 49, 20 : tāsakaraṇena ~ā ti saṅkhaṃ gatāya taṇhāya); Nidd I 488, 12 (tasā ti yesaṃ ~ā taṇhā appahīnā, Ee, Se so; Be tasitā; Ce tasinā) ≠ Ap-a 130, 13 ( eds ~ā); Sadd 489, 26 (tasa pipāsāyaṃ: … ~ā); 634, 6 (appakkharānaṃ bahuttaṃ aññathattaṃ ca: … taṇhā ~ā); — see also taṇhā.

tasita.p: [Tasa+ita] (ti) CL=7 [Moga. Pañcikā, 4. 45. Tasa+i+ta. Nīti, dhā. 239.] (1) (A) One who wants to enjoy. (B) One who reaches to the state of feeling to enjoy. (C) One who happens lust (or) One who has lust. (D) Reach to the state of happening lust. (E) It should be overcome and tortured lust. (2) (A) One who is frightening. (B) It reaches to the state of feeling fear. (3) "Lust or passion" which is hungry (characteristic).
